Bayesian q-values from local false sign rates

Source: R/hurdle.R
bm_qvalue.Rd

For each result, the q-value is the expected proportion of sign errors among all results with a local false sign rate (lfsr) at most as large (the running mean of the sorted lfsr values). Selecting the results with qval <= 0.1 controls the Bayesian false sign rate at 10%.

Usage

bm_qvalue(lfsr)

Arguments

lfsr

Numeric vector of local false sign rates; NA values get NA.

Value

Numeric vector of q-values, same length as lfsr.

Examples

bm_qvalue(c(0.001, 0.2, 0.01, NA))
#> [1] 0.00100000 0.07033333 0.00550000         NA
